Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Heard Sri Manish Kr. Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ramesh Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present application has been filed to direct the court below to decide Sessions Case No. 1215 of 2021 (State of U.P. vs. Amit Sharma and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 147 of 2015, u/s 323,
504, 506, 498A, 376, 511 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Juhi, District Kanpur Nagar, pending before Additional Sessions Judge/FTC-41 (Offences against women), Kanpur Nagar, within a stipulated period.

opennyai_summary.decision:
As the present case relates to crime against women, therefore, it should be decided expeditiously.
Considering the facts and circumstances, Additional Sessions Judge/FTC-41 (Offences against women), Kanpur Nagar is directed to conclude the trial of Sessions Case No. 1215 of 2021 (State of U.P. vs. Amit Sharma and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 147 of 2015, u/s 323, 504, 506,
